title: ee.mesh.revoke_lane.v1
description: Successful result of `ee mesh revoke-lane <peer-id> --lane <lane>`. The idempotent narrowing mutation records deny, always advances the exact target's grant generation, and audits in the same transaction. Advancing the generation invalidates every outstanding preview and prevents a stale approval from re-enabling the lane.

newGrantGeneration.description: Generation committed by this mutation. It advances even when the effective lane decision was already deny, so every earlier preview stays stale.

auditId.description: Opaque identifier of the durable lane-revocation audit row.

remoteErasureGuaranteed.description: Always false: a local-first lane revocation can stop future serving but cannot prove deletion of bytes already disclosed.

residual.const: Revocation stops future serving but cannot erase bytes the peer already cached or copied.

peerId.description: Opaque enrolled-peer lookup handle. It is not itself a cryptographic identity.
